tagline: An S3-compatible object store written in Rust. Still a pre-release: every version so far is a release candidate.
description: RustFS is an S3-compatible object store written in Rust under the Apache-2.0 licence, one of the alternatives people turned to after MinIO's open edition stopped moving.
author: Junker der Provinz

tips.before_install: Starts with RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY as admin and RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY as casaos. Change them under Custom Installation before you store real data.

title: RustFS
